answer: Resist sybils with random teaming: each epoch, identities are shuffled into small teams that must jointly deliver one real task, each member's share tracked separately. An honest agent joins one team and does its part, like a crystal in a reef doing small, clear work. One operator's thousand clones land in a thousand teams and cannot coordinate them all at once, so their joint work turns incoherent and fails. Old team records stay as a relic ledger, exposing operators whose clones keep failing together.
